newsitem.title: USA: Suicide is official cause of California cult deaths.
newsitem.headline: Suicide is official cause of California cult deaths.

text.p: Suicide has been ruled as the official cause of death of 39 Heaven's Gate cult members whose bodies were found last month in a Rancho Sante Fe mansion, the San Diego County Medical Examiner's Office said on Friday.
San Diego County Sheriff's detectives, meanwhile, said the investigation into the suicides, which grabbed worldwide attention, was all but closed.
All of the cult members used phenobarbital and all but one used a plastic bag to induce suffocation, according to the medical examiner's autopsy report.

In addition, heart disease, or "constrictive coronary arteriosclerosis," contributed to the death of cult leader Marshall Applewhite, who committed suicide by combining alcohol, phenobarbital and the pain killer hydrocodone.
His death was also associated with "asphyxia by plastic bag," the report said.

According to tapes and information left behind, cult members committed suicide hoping to enter a higher plane of existence where they could join space aliens. Many of them believed they were sent to Earth to inhabit human bodies and that the time had come for them to shed them.
The only cult member who did not use a plastic bag was identified as Julie Elmira Lamontagne. Medical Examiner Dr. Brian Blackbourne said she died from a combination of phenobarbital and hydrocodone.

Asphyxia by plastic bag contributed to 38 other deaths, according to the report, which based its findings on the presence in the trash can behind the house of nine plastic bags with rubber bands around them and the relatively low, nonlethal levels of phenobarbital in many of the bodies.
In addition, a note recovered from the scene said "Use plastic bag to be sure," the report said.

Thirty cult members died by combining alcohol and phenobarbital and four used just phenobarbital. Traces of the barbiturate butalbital were found in one of the victims, while four others, including Applewhite, showed traces of hydrocodone.
Earlier reports by the sheriff's department said Applewhite and his followers died after mixing phenobarbital with apple sauce or pudding before washing it down with vodka.
Sheriff's detectives have been unable to trace where the cult members got the drug, but believe their source was in Tijuana, Mexico.
